sentences.zh: 【梁紀十七】　著雍執徐，一年。

translations.literal: [Liang Records 17] Zhiyong Zhixu; one year in all.
translations.idiomatic: [Liang Records 17] Zhiyong Zhixu—one year in all.

translations.literal: Great Ancestor Emperor Wu, seventeenth year of the Taqing era (
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Wu of Liang, seventeenth year of Taqing (

translations.idiomatic: wuchen, AD 548)

sentences.zh: 春，正月，己亥，慕容紹宗以鐵騎五千夾擊侯景，景誑其眾曰：「汝輩家屬已為高澄所殺。

translations.literal: In spring, the first month, on jihai, Murong Shaozong with five thousand iron cavalry attacked Hou Jing from both flanks; Jing deceived his troops, saying: "Your families have all been killed by Gao Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: In spring, the first month, on jihai, Murong Shaozong struck Hou Jing with five thousand iron cavalry from both flanks. Jing lied to his men: "Gao Cheng has killed your families.

sentences.zh: 」眾信之。

translations.literal: " The troops believed him.
translations.idiomatic: " The troops believed him.

sentences.zh: 紹宗遙呼曰：「汝輩家屬並完，若歸，官勳如舊。

translations.literal: Shaozong shouted from afar: "Your families are all safe; if you return, rank and merit will be as before.
translations.idiomatic: Shaozong shouted from afar: "Your families are all safe. Return, and rank and merit stay as before.

sentences.zh: 」被發向北斗為誓。

translations.literal: " He let down his hair and swore toward the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: " He let down his hair and swore toward the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 景士卒不樂南渡，其將暴顯等各帥所部降於紹宗。

translations.literal: Jing's soldiers were unwilling to cross south; his generals Bao Xian and others each led their commands in surrender to Shaozong.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's soldiers refused to cross south; his generals Bao Xian and others each surrendered their commands to Shaozong.

sentences.zh: 景眾大潰，爭赴渦水，水為之不流。

translations.literal: Jing's army collapsed in great rout, rushing into the Wo River until the water would not flow.
translations.idiomatic: Jing's army routed in chaos, hurling themselves into the Wo River until the water stopped flowing.

sentences.zh: 景與腹心數騎自硤石濟淮，稍收散卒，得步騎八百人，南過小城，人登陴詬之曰：「跛奴！

translations.literal: Jing with a few trusted horsemen crossed the Huai at Xiashi, gradually gathered scattered troops, and got eight hundred foot and horse; passing a small town southward, men mounted the walls and reviled him: "Cripple!
translations.idiomatic: Jing fled across the Huai at Xiashi with a handful of trusted riders, gathered scattered troops until he had eight hundred foot and horse, and passed a small town where men on the walls shouted: "Cripple!

sentences.zh: 欲何為邪！

translations.literal: "What do you think you're doing!"
translations.idiomatic: "What do you think you're doing!"

sentences.zh: 」景怒，破城，殺詬者而去。

translations.literal: " Jing in anger stormed the town, killed the revilers, and left.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing in rage stormed the town, killed the revilers, and left.

sentences.zh: 晝夜兼行，追軍不敢逼。

translations.literal: Marching day and night together, the pursuing army did not dare press close.
translations.idiomatic: He marched day and night; the pursuers did not dare press close.

sentences.zh: 使謂紹宗曰：「景若就擒，公復何用！

translations.literal: He sent word to Shaozong: "If Jing is captured, of what use will you be!
translations.idiomatic: He sent word to Shaozong: "If Jing is taken, what use are you then!

sentences.zh: 」紹宗乃縱之。

translations.literal: " Shaozong then let him go.
translations.idiomatic: " Shaozong then let him go.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以尚書僕射謝舉為尚書令，守吏部尚書王克為僕射。

translations.literal: On xinchou, Vice Minister of the Masters of Writing Xie Ju was made Minister of the Masters of Writing, and Acting Minister of Personnel Wang Ke was made Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou, vice minister Xie Ju was made minister of the Masters of Writing, and acting minister of personnel Wang Ke was made vice minister.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，豫州刺史羊鴉仁以東魏軍漸逼，稱糧運不繼，棄懸瓠，還義陽；

translations.literal: On jiachen, Yuzhou Inspector Yang Yaren, as Eastern Wei armies pressed nearer, claimed grain transport could not keep up, abandoned Xuanhuo, and returned to Yiyang;
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Yuzhou inspector Yang Yaren, as Eastern Wei armies closed in, claimed his grain lines were failing, abandoned Xuanhuo, and withdrew to Yiyang;

sentences.zh: 殷州刺史羊思達亦棄項城走；

translations.literal: Yinzhou Inspector Yang Sida also abandoned Xiangcheng and fled;
translations.idiomatic: Yinzhou inspector Yang Sida also abandoned Xiangcheng and fled;

sentences.zh: 東魏人皆據之。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei men all seized them.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei forces took both cities.

sentences.zh: 上怒，責讓鴉仁。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and rebuked Yaren.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was furious and rebuked Yaren.

sentences.zh: 鴉仁懼，啟申後期，頓軍淮上。

translations.literal: Yaren feared and memorialized asking delay; he halted his army on the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: Yaren, afraid, asked for more time and halted his army on the Huai.

sentences.zh: 侯景既敗，不知所適，時鄱陽王范除南豫州刺史，未至。

translations.literal: Hou Jing having been defeated, did not know where to go; at the time Prince of Poyang Fan had been appointed Southern Yuzhou Inspector but had not yet arrived.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing, defeated, did not know where to turn. Prince Fan of Poyang had been appointed Southern Yuzhou inspector but had not yet arrived.

sentences.zh: 馬頭戍主劉神茂，素為監州事韋黯所不容，聞景至，故往候之，景問曰：「壽陽去此不遠，城池險固，欲往投之，韋黯其納我乎？

translations.literal: Matou Garrison Commander Liu Shenmao had long been ill tolerated by Acting Inspector Wei An; hearing Jing had come, he therefore went to meet him. Jing asked: "Shouchun is not far from here, its walls strong and secure—I wish to go throw myself on it; will Wei An admit me?
translations.idiomatic: Matou garrison commander Liu Shenmao had long been at odds with acting inspector Wei An. Hearing Jing was near, he went to meet him. Jing asked: "Shouchun is close, its walls strong—I mean to throw myself on it. Will Wei An take me in?

sentences.zh: 」神茂曰：「黯雖據城，是監州耳。

translations.literal: " Shenmao said: "Though An holds the city, he is only acting inspector.
translations.idiomatic: " Shenmao said: "An holds the city, but he is only acting inspector.

sentences.zh: 王若馳至近郊，彼必出迎，因而執之，可以集事。

translations.literal: "If Your Highness gallops to the near suburbs, he is sure to come out to welcome you; seize him then and you can gather the affair."
translations.idiomatic: "If Your Highness rides to the near suburbs, he will surely come out to welcome you. Seize him then and the thing is done."

sentences.zh: 得城之後，徐以啟聞，朝廷喜王南歸，必不責也。

translations.literal: "After gaining the city, slowly report upward; the court will rejoice that Your Highness returns south and surely will not blame you."
translations.idiomatic: "Once you hold the city, report upward at leisure. The court will rejoice at your return south and will not blame you."

sentences.zh: 」景執其手曰：「天教也！

translations.literal: " Jing grasped his hand and said: "Heaven teaches it!
translations.idiomatic: " Jing grasped his hand and said: "Heaven ordains it!

sentences.zh: 」神茂請帥步騎百人先為鄉導。

translations.literal: " Shenmao asked to lead a hundred foot and horse ahead as guides.
translations.idiomatic: " Shenmao asked to lead a hundred foot and horse ahead as guides.

sentences.zh: 壬子，景夜至壽陽城下；

translations.literal: On renzi, Jing by night reached below Shouchun city;
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Jing reached Shouchun by night;

sentences.zh: 韋黯以為賊也，授甲登陴。

translations.literal: Wei An thought them bandits, issued armor, and mounted the walls.
translations.idiomatic: Wei An thought them bandits, issued armor, and manned the walls.

sentences.zh: 景遣其徒告曰：「河南王戰敗來投此鎮，願速開門。

translations.literal: Jing sent his men to announce: "The King of Henan, defeated in battle, comes to throw himself on this garrison—open the gates at once.
translations.idiomatic: Jing sent men to announce: "The King of Henan, defeated, comes to this garrison—open the gates at once.

sentences.zh: 」黯曰：「既不奉敕，不敢聞命。

translations.literal: " An said: "Having no imperial order, I dare not heed the command.
translations.idiomatic: " An said: "Without an imperial order I dare not obey.

sentences.zh: 」景謂神茂曰：「事不諧矣。

translations.literal: " Jing said to Shenmao: "The affair will not succeed.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing told Shenmao: "The affair will not succeed.

sentences.zh: 」神茂曰：「黯懦而寡智，可說下也。

translations.literal: " Shenmao said: "An is cowardly and short of wit—he can be talked down.
translations.idiomatic: " Shenmao said: "An is cowardly and witless. He can be talked down.

sentences.zh: 」乃遣壽陽徐思玉入見黯曰：「河南王為朝廷所重，君所知也。

translations.literal: " He then sent Shouchun's Xu Siyu in to see An and say: "The King of Henan is weighty in the court's eyes, as you know.
translations.idiomatic: " He sent Xu Siyu of Shouchun in to see An: "The King of Henan carries weight at court, as you know.

sentences.zh: 今失利來投，何得不受？

translations.literal: "Now defeated and come to throw himself on you—how can you not receive him?"
translations.idiomatic: "Now he comes defeated—how can you refuse him?"

sentences.zh: 」黯曰：「吾之受命，唯知守城；

translations.literal: " An said: "My commission is only to know how to hold the city;
translations.idiomatic: " An said: "My commission is only to hold the city;

sentences.zh: 河南自敗，何預吾事！

translations.literal: "Henan defeated himself—what has that to do with me!"
translations.idiomatic: "Henan lost on his own—what is that to me!"

sentences.zh: 」思玉曰：「國家付君以閫外之略，今君不肯開城，若魏追兵來至，河南為魏所殺，君豈能獨存！

translations.literal: " Siyu said: "The state entrusted you with authority beyond the passes; now you refuse to open the city—if Wei pursuers come and Henan is killed by Wei, can you alone survive!
translations.idiomatic: " Siyu said: "The state gave you authority beyond the passes. Refuse to open the gates, and when Wei pursuers come and Henan is killed, can you survive alone!

sentences.zh: 縱使或存，何顏以見朝廷？

translations.literal: "Even if you somehow survive, with what face can you see the court?"
translations.idiomatic: "Even if you live, with what face will you see the court?"

sentences.zh: 」黯然之。

translations.literal: " An's color darkened.
translations.idiomatic: " An's face fell.

sentences.zh: 思玉出報，景大悅曰：「活我者，卿也！

translations.literal: Siyu came out and reported; Jing was greatly pleased and said: "You are the one who saved my life!
translations.idiomatic: Siyu reported; Jing was delighted: "You saved my life!

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，黯開門納景，景遣其將分守四門，詰責黯，將斬之；

translations.literal: " On guichou, An opened the gates and admitted Jing; Jing sent his generals to guard the four gates, rebuked An, and was about to behead him;
translations.idiomatic: " On guichou An opened the gates and admitted Jing. Jing posted generals at the four gates, rebuked An, and was about to behead him;

sentences.zh: 既而撫手大笑，置酒極歡。

translations.literal: then he clapped his hands, laughed greatly, and set out wine in extreme revelry.
translations.idiomatic: then he clapped his hands, laughed, and set out wine in great revelry.

sentences.zh: 黯，睿之子也。

translations.literal: An was the son of Rui.
translations.idiomatic: An was the son of Wei Rui.

sentences.zh: 朝廷聞景敗，未得審問；

translations.literal: The court heard Jing was defeated but could not yet verify the facts;
translations.idiomatic: The court heard Jing was defeated but could not yet verify it;

sentences.zh: 或云：「景與將士盡沒。

translations.literal: some said: "Jing and his officers and soldiers are all destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: some said: "Jing and all his officers and men are dead.

sentences.zh: 」上下鹹以為憂。

translations.literal: " High and low alike took it as cause for worry.
translations.idiomatic: " Court and people alike grieved.

sentences.zh: 侍中、太子詹事何敬容詣東宮，太子曰：「淮北始更有信，侯景定得身免，不如所傳。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant and Crown Prince Household Governor He Jingrong went to the Eastern Palace; the crown prince said: "There is fresh word from north of the Huai—Hou Jing will surely escape with his life; it is not as reported.
translations.idiomatic: Palace attendant and crown prince household governor He Jingrong went to the Eastern Palace. The crown prince said: "Fresh word from north of the Huai—Hou Jing will surely escape. It is not as reported.

sentences.zh: 」敬容對曰：「得景遂死，深為朝廷之福。

translations.literal: " Jingrong replied: "If Jing were to die at once, that would be deep fortune for the court.
translations.idiomatic: " Jingrong replied: "If Jing died at once, that would be the court's great fortune.

sentences.zh: 」太子失色，問其故，敬容曰：「景翻覆叛臣，終當亂國。

translations.literal: " The crown prince changed color and asked the reason; Jingrong said: "Jing is a turncoat rebel minister— in the end he will throw the state into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince blanched and asked why. Jingrong said: "Jing is a turncoat rebel—in the end he will ruin the realm.

sentences.zh: 」太子於玄圃自講《老》、《莊》，敬容謂學士吳孜曰：「昔西晉祖尚玄虛，使中原淪於胡、羯。

translations.literal: " The crown prince in the Mystic Garden lectured on the Laozi and Zhuangzi himself; Jingrong told Academician Wu Zi: "In olden days Western Jin's founders honored empty mystery and let the central plains fall to Hu and Jie.
translations.idiomatic: " The crown prince lectured on the Laozi and Zhuangzi in the Mystic Garden. Jingrong told academician Wu Zi: "Western Jin's founders worshipped empty mystery and lost the central plains to the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 今東宮復爾，江南亦將為戎乎！

translations.literal: "Now the Eastern Palace does the same—will Jiangnan also become a land of war!"
translations.idiomatic: "Now the Eastern Palace does the same—will the south also become a battlefield!"

sentences.zh: 甲寅，景遣儀同三司於子悅馳以敗聞，並自求貶削；

translations.literal: On jiayin, Jing sent Acting Three Excellencies Yu Ziyue in haste with news of defeat and himself asked to be demoted;
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Jing sent Acting Three Excellencies Yu Ziyue in haste with news of defeat and asked to be demoted;

sentences.zh: 優詔不許。

translations.literal: a gracious edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: a gracious edict refused.

sentences.zh: 景復求資給，上以景兵新破，未忍移易。

translations.literal: Jing again asked for supplies; the emperor, because Jing's army was newly broken, was unwilling to shift him.
translations.idiomatic: Jing again asked for supplies. The emperor, since Jing's army was freshly broken, would not move him.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，即以景為南豫州牧，本官如故；

translations.literal: On yimao, Jing was immediately made Governor of Southern Yuzhou, his original posts as before;
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Jing was made governor of Southern Yuzhou, his original posts unchanged;

sentences.zh: 更以鄱陽王范為合州刺史，鎮合肥。

translations.literal: Prince of Poyang Fan was instead made Hezhou Inspector and garrisoned Hefei.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Fan of Poyang was made Hezhou inspector and garrisoned Hefei.

sentences.zh: 光祿大夫蕭介上表諫曰：「竊聞侯景以渦陽敗績，隻馬歸命，陛下不悔前禍，復敕容納。

translations.literal: Supervisor of the Bright Hall Xiao Jie memorialized in remonstrance: "I have heard that Hou Jing, defeated at Woyang, came back alone on horseback to submit his fate; Your Majesty did not regret the earlier disaster and again ordered him received.
translations.idiomatic: Supervisor of the Bright Hall Xiao Jie remonstrated: "I hear Hou Jing, defeated at Woyang, came back alone to submit. Your Majesty did not regret the earlier disaster and received him again.

sentences.zh: 臣聞凶人之性不移，天下之惡一也。

translations.literal: "I have heard that the nature of a vicious man does not change—the evil under heaven is one.
translations.idiomatic: "I hear the nature of a vicious man never changes—evil under heaven is one.

sentences.zh: 昔呂布殺丁原以事董卓，終誅董而為賊；

translations.literal: "In olden days Lü Bu killed Ding Yuan to serve Dong Zhuo, then killed Dong and became a bandit;
translations.idiomatic: "Lü Bu killed Ding Yuan for Dong Zhuo, then killed Dong and became a bandit;

sentences.zh: 劉牢反王恭以歸晉，還背晉以構妖。

translations.literal: "Liu Lao turned against Wang Gong to join Jin, then betrayed Jin to raise rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: "Liu Lao turned on Wang Gong for Jin, then betrayed Jin and raised rebellion.

sentences.zh: 何者？

translations.literal: "Why is that?"
translations.idiomatic: "Why?"

sentences.zh: 狼子野心，終無馴狎之性，養虎之喻，必見饑噬之禍。

translations.literal: "A wolf cub's wild heart never knows tame nature; the parable of rearing a tiger ends in the hunger-bite disaster.
translations.idiomatic: "A wolf cub's heart is never tame; feed a tiger and hunger will devour you.

sentences.zh: 侯景以凶狡之才，荷高歡卵翼之遇，位忝台司，任居方伯，然而高歡墳土未干，即還反噬。

translations.literal: "Hou Jing with vicious cunning talent received Gao Huan's brooding favor; his rank matched the Secretariat, his post was a regional lord—yet Gao Huan's grave earth was not dry before he turned to bite back.
translations.idiomatic: "Hou Jing, vicious and cunning, owed Gao Huan brooding favor; he ranked with the Secretariat and ruled a region—yet before Gao Huan's grave was dry he turned to bite.

sentences.zh: 逆力不逮，乃復逃死關西；

translations.literal: "His rebellious strength did not reach—then he fled death to Guanxi;
translations.idiomatic: "His rebellion failed—then he fled for his life to Guanxi;

sentences.zh: 宇文不容，故復投身於我。

translations.literal: "the Yuwen would not tolerate him, so he threw himself on us again.
translations.idiomatic: "the Yuwen would not have him, so he threw himself on us again.

sentences.zh: 陛下前者所以不逆細流，正欲比屬國降胡以討匈奴，冀獲一戰之效耳；

translations.literal: "Your Majesty earlier did not oppose the trickle, precisely wishing to compare subject-state surrendered Hu against the Xiongnu and hope for one battle's effect;
translations.idiomatic: "Your Majesty earlier did not refuse the trickle, meaning to use a surrendered barbarian against the Xiongnu and win one battle;

sentences.zh: 今既亡師失地，直是境上之匹夫，陛下愛匹夫而棄與國，臣竊不取也。

translations.literal: "now having lost army and territory he is plainly a man of the border—Your Majesty cherishes a common man and abandons the state allied with you; I privately think it unworthy.
translations.idiomatic: "now he has lost army and land and is a border vagabond. Cherish him and abandon your ally—I think it unworthy.

sentences.zh: 若國家猶待其更鳴之辰，歲暮之效，臣竊惟侯景必非歲暮之臣；

translations.literal: "If the state still waits for his season of renewed song, his year's-end effect—I privately think Hou Jing will surely not be a year's-end minister;
translations.idiomatic: "If the state waits for his late loyalty, I think Hou Jing will never be loyal in old age;

sentences.zh: 棄鄉國如脫屣，背君親如遺芥，豈知遠慕聖德，為江、淮之純臣乎！

translations.literal: "abandoning home and state like casting off shoes, turning from lord and kin like dropping mustard—does he know to admire sage virtue from afar and be a pure minister of the Jiang and Huai!"
translations.idiomatic: "He casts off home like shoes and kin like mustard—does he mean to be a pure minister of the Jiang and Huai!"

sentences.zh: 事跡顯然，無可致惑。

translations.literal: "The facts are plain—no confusion need be invited.
translations.idiomatic: "The facts are plain.

sentences.zh: 臣朽老疾侵，不應干預朝政；

translations.literal: "Your servant is decayed and old, disease encroaching—he should not interfere in court governance;
translations.idiomatic: "I am old and ill and should not meddle in court affairs;

sentences.zh: 但楚囊將死，有城郢之忠，衛魚臨亡，亦有尸諫之節。

translations.literal: "yet when the Chu satchel was about to die he had the loyalty of defending Ying; when the Wei fish faced death it also had the integrity of corpse-remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: "yet when the Chu satchel was dying he defended Ying; when the Wei fish faced death it remonstrated with its corpse.

sentences.zh: 臣忝為宗室遺老，敢忘劉向之心！

translations.literal: "Your servant, unworthy as a surviving elder of the imperial clan, dares not forget the heart of Liu Xiang!"
translations.idiomatic: "I, an unworthy surviving elder of the clan, dare not forget Liu Xiang's heart!"

sentences.zh: 」上歎息其忠，然不能用。

translations.literal: " The emperor sighed at his loyalty but could not employ the advice.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor sighed at his loyalty but would not follow it.

sentences.zh: 介，思話之孫也。

translations.literal: Jie was the grandson of Sihua.
translations.idiomatic: Jie was the grandson of Xiao Sihua.

sentences.zh: 己未，東魏大將軍澄朝於鄴。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Eastern Wei Grand General Cheng entered court at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Eastern Wei grand general Gao Cheng entered court at Ye.

sentences.zh: 魏以開府儀同三司趙貴為司空。

translations.literal: Western Wei made Acting Three Excellencies Zhao Gui Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Western Wei made Zhao Gui Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 魏皇孫生，大赦。

translations.literal: Western Wei's imperial grandson was born; general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: A Western Wei imperial grandson was born; general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 二月，東魏殺其南兗州刺史石長宣，討侯景之黨也；

translations.literal: In the second month, Eastern Wei killed its Southern Yanzhou Inspector Shi Changxuan, punishing Hou Jing's faction;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month Eastern Wei killed Southern Yanzhou inspector Shi Changxuan, punishing Hou Jing's faction;

sentences.zh: 其餘為景所脅從者，皆赦之。

translations.literal: the rest who had been coerced to follow Jing were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: the rest coerced to follow Jing were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 東魏既得懸瓠、項城，悉復舊境。

translations.literal: Eastern Wei having taken Xuanhuo and Xiangcheng fully restored the old borders.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Wei, having taken Xuanhuo and Xiangcheng, fully restored the old borders.

sentences.zh: 大將軍澄數遣書移，復求通好；

translations.literal: Grand General Cheng repeatedly sent letters and proclamations again seeking renewed friendship;
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Gao Cheng repeatedly sent letters seeking renewed friendship;

sentences.zh: 朝廷未之許。

translations.literal: the court did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: the court refused.

sentences.zh: 澄謂貞陽侯淵明曰：「先王與梁主和好，十有餘年。

translations.literal: Cheng said to Marquis of Zhenyang Yuanming: "The former king and the Liang ruler were at peace more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Cheng told Marquis Xiao Yuanming of Zhenyang: "The former king and the Liang ruler were at peace more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 聞彼禮佛文云：『奉為魏主，並及先王。

translations.literal: "I hear their Buddhist prayer text says: 'Offered for the Wei ruler, and for the former king as well.
translations.idiomatic: "I hear their Buddhist prayer says: 'Offered for the Wei ruler and for the former king as well.

sentences.zh: 』此乃梁主厚意；

translations.literal: ' That is the Liang ruler's deep goodwill;
translations.idiomatic: ' That is the Liang ruler's goodwill;

sentences.zh: 不謂一朝失信，致此紛擾，知非梁主本心，當是侯景扇動耳，宜遣使咨論。

translations.literal: "I did not expect one morning's broken faith to bring this turmoil—I know it is not the Liang ruler's true heart; it must be Hou Jing's incitement. Envoys should be sent to consult.
translations.idiomatic: "I did not expect faith broken overnight and this turmoil. I know it is not the Liang ruler's heart—it is Hou Jing's doing. Send envoys to consult.

sentences.zh: 若梁主不忘舊好，吾亦不敢違先王之意，諸人並即遣還，侯景家屬亦當同遣。

translations.literal: "If the Liang ruler does not forget the old friendship, I too dare not violate the former king's intent—all captives will be sent back at once, and Hou Jing's family as well.
translations.idiomatic: "If the Liang ruler remembers old friendship, I dare not violate the former king's intent. All captives go back, and Hou Jing's family too.

sentences.zh: 」淵明乃遣省事夏侯僧辯奉啟於上，稱「勃海王弘厚長者，若更通好，當聽淵明還。

translations.literal: " Yuanming then sent Staff Officer Xiahou Sengbian with a memorial to the emperor, stating "Prince of Bohai Hong is a generous elder—if friendship is renewed, Yuanming may return.
translations.idiomatic: " Yuanming sent staff officer Xiahou Sengbian with a memorial: "Prince Hong of Bohai is a generous elder. Renew friendship and Yuanming may return.

sentences.zh: 」上得啟，流涕，與朝臣議之。

translations.literal: " The emperor received the memorial, wept, and deliberated with the ministers.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor received it, wept, and debated with his ministers.

sentences.zh: 右衛將軍朱異、御史中丞張綰等皆曰：「靜寇息民，和實為便。

translations.literal: Right Guard General Zhu Yi and Imperial Censor Zhang Chuo and others all said: "Stilling bandits and resting the people—peace is truly convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Right Guard General Zhu Yi and imperial censor Zhang Chuo and others said: "Still bandits and rest the people—peace is best.

sentences.zh: 」司農卿傅岐獨曰：「高澄何事須和？

translations.literal: " Minister of Finance Fu Qi alone said: "Why would Gao Cheng need peace at all?
translations.idiomatic: " Minister of Finance Fu Qi alone said: "Why would Gao Cheng need peace?

sentences.zh: 必是設間，故命貞陽遣使，欲令侯景自疑。

translations.literal: "It must be a stratagem to sow discord—therefore he ordered Zhenyang to send envoys, wishing to make Hou Jing suspect.
translations.idiomatic: "It must be a stratagem. He ordered Zhenyang to send envoys to make Hou Jing suspicious.

sentences.zh: 景意不安，必圖禍亂。

translations.literal: "Jing's mind uneasy will surely plot disaster and chaos.
translations.idiomatic: "Uneasy, Jing will plot disaster.

sentences.zh: 若許通好，正墮其計中。

translations.literal: "If peace is granted, you fall right into his scheme.
translations.idiomatic: "Grant peace and you fall into his scheme.

sentences.zh: 」異等固執宜和，上亦厭用兵，乃從異言，賜淵明書曰：「知高大將軍禮汝不薄，省啟，甚以慰懷。

translations.literal: " Yi and the rest stubbornly held that peace was fitting; the emperor also wearied of war and followed Yi's words, bestowing on Yuanming a letter: "Knowing Grand General Gao treats you not poorly—I have read your memorial and am much comforted.
translations.idiomatic: " Yi and the rest insisted on peace; the emperor, weary of war, followed Yi and wrote Yuanming: "I know Grand General Gao treats you well. Your memorial comforts me.

sentences.zh: 當別遣行人，重敦鄰睦。

translations.literal: "I shall separately send envoys to renew neighborly friendship."
translations.idiomatic: "I shall send other envoys to renew neighborly friendship."

sentences.zh: 僧辯還，過壽陽，侯景竊訪知之，攝問，具服。

translations.literal: Sengbian returned, passed Shouchun; Hou Jing secretly learned of it, seized and interrogated him, and he confessed fully.
translations.idiomatic: Sengbian returned by way of Shouchun. Hou Jing learned of it secretly, seized and interrogated him, and he confessed.

sentences.zh: 乃寫答淵明之書，陳啟於上曰：「高氏心懷鴆毒，怨盈北土，人願天從，歡身殞越。

translations.literal: Jing then copied a reply to Yuanming's letter and memorialized the emperor: "The Gao house harbors poison in its heart, resentment fills the northern land; men's wishes and Heaven's will aligned—Huan's body perished.
translations.idiomatic: Jing copied a reply to Yuanming and memorialized: "The Gao house harbors poison; the north seethes with resentment. Heaven answered men's wishes—Gao Huan is dead.

sentences.zh: 子澄嗣惡，計滅待時，所以昧此一勝者，蓋大蕩澄心以盈凶毒耳。

translations.literal: "Son Cheng inherits evil, plotting destruction while waiting his hour; the reason he glossed over this one victory is that he meant to cleanse Cheng's heart to fill his vicious poison.
translations.idiomatic: "Son Cheng inherits evil and waits to destroy us. He glossed this victory only to cleanse his heart and fill his poison.

sentences.zh: 澄苟行合天心，腹心無疾，又何急急奉璧求和？

translations.literal: "If Cheng truly acted with Heaven's heart and had no sickness in his inner circle, why urgently offer jade and seek peace?
translations.idiomatic: "If Cheng truly had Heaven's favor and no sickness within, why rush to offer jade and seek peace?

sentences.zh: 豈不以秦兵扼其喉，胡騎迫其背，故甘辭厚幣，取安大國。

translations.literal: "Is it not because Qin troops choke his throat and Hu horse press his back—therefore sweet words and thick gifts to secure safety in a great state.
translations.idiomatic: "Is it not because Qin troops choke his throat and Hu cavalry press his back—so sweet words and thick gifts buy safety in a great state?

sentences.zh: 臣聞『一日縱敵，數世之患』，何惜高澄一豎，以棄億兆之心！

translations.literal: "Your servant has heard 'One day's loose enemy is generations' calamity'—why spare Gao Cheng, one boy, and abandon the hearts of hundreds of millions!"
translations.idiomatic: "I have heard: 'Loose the enemy one day, calamity for generations.' Why spare Gao Cheng, one boy, and abandon the hearts of the millions!"

sentences.zh: 竊以北魏安強，莫過天監之始，鐘離之役，匹馬不歸。

translations.literal: "I privately think Western Wei's strength and security never exceeded the start of Tianjian; at the battle of Zhongli not one horse returned.
translations.idiomatic: "Western Wei's strength never exceeded Tianjian's start; at Zhongli not one horse returned.

sentences.zh: 當其強也，陛下尚伐而取之；

translations.literal: "When they were strong, Your Majesty still attacked and took from them;
translations.idiomatic: "When they were strong, Your Majesty still attacked and took;

sentences.zh: 及其弱也，反慮而和之。

translations.literal: "when they are weak, you instead worry and make peace.
translations.idiomatic: "when they are weak, you worry and make peace.

sentences.zh: 捨已成之功，縱垂死之虜，使其假命強梁，以遺後世，非直愚臣扼腕，實亦志士痛心。

translations.literal: "Casting off achieved merit, loosing a dying captive, letting him borrow life and grow strong in Liang to bequeath to later ages—not only does this foolish minister wring his wrists; truly men of resolve are heart-sick.
translations.idiomatic: "Cast off achieved merit, loose a dying captive, let him borrow life and grow strong to bequeath to later ages—not only does this fool wring his wrists; men of resolve are heart-sick.

sentences.zh: 昔伍相奔吳，楚邦卒滅；

translations.literal: "In olden days Minister Wu fled to Wu and the state of Chu was destroyed at last;
translations.idiomatic: "Minister Wu fled to Wu and Chu was destroyed;

sentences.zh: 陳平去項，劉氏用興。

translations.literal: "Chen Ping left Xiang and the house of Liu rose.
translations.idiomatic: "Chen Ping left Xiang and Liu rose.

sentences.zh: 臣雖才劣古人，心同往事。

translations.literal: "Your servant's talent is inferior to the ancients, but his heart matches past affairs.
translations.idiomatic: "My talent is less than the ancients', but my heart matches theirs.

sentences.zh: 誠知高澄忌賈在翟，惡會居秦，求盟請和，冀除其患。

translations.literal: "I truly know Gao Cheng hates Jia in Zhai and evil meeting in Qin—seeking alliance and peace, hoping to remove his trouble.
translations.idiomatic: "I know Gao Cheng hates rivals in his house and foes abroad—he seeks alliance to remove trouble.

sentences.zh: 若臣死有益，萬殞無辭。

translations.literal: "If your servant's death would benefit, ten thousand deaths without refusal.
translations.idiomatic: "If my death would help, ten thousand deaths without refusal.

sentences.zh: 唯恐千載，有穢良史。

translations.literal: "I only fear that after a thousand years there will stain on good history.
translations.idiomatic: "I only fear a thousand years hence history will be stained.

sentences.zh: 」景又致書於朱異，餉金三百兩；

translations.literal: " Jing also sent a letter to Zhu Yi and presented three hundred taels of gold;
translations.idiomatic: " Jing also sent Zhu Yi a letter and three hundred taels of gold;

sentences.zh: 異納金而不通其啟。

translations.literal: Yi accepted the gold but did not pass on his memorial.
translations.idiomatic: Yi took the gold but did not pass on his memorial.

sentences.zh: 己卯，上遣使吊澄。

translations.literal: On jimao, the emperor sent envoys to condole Cheng.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao the emperor sent envoys to condole Gao Cheng.

sentences.zh: 景又啟曰：「臣與高氏，釁隙已深，仰憑威靈，期雪仇恥；

translations.literal: Jing again memorialized: "Your servant and the Gao house have rancor already deep; relying on Your Majesty's majesty, he hopes to wash away shame and vengeance;
translations.idiomatic: Jing memorialized again: "I and the Gao house have deep rancor. Relying on Your Majesty's majesty I hope to wash away shame;

sentences.zh: 今陛下復與高氏連和，使臣何地自處！

translations.literal: "now Your Majesty again joins with the Gao house—where can your servant place himself!"
translations.idiomatic: "now Your Majesty joins the Gao again—where can I stand!"

sentences.zh: 乞申後戰，宣暢皇威！

translations.literal: "I beg to defer further battle and spread imperial majesty!"
translations.idiomatic: "I beg defer further battle and spread imperial majesty!"

sentences.zh: 」上報之曰：「朕與公大義已定，豈有成而相納，敗而相棄乎！

translations.literal: " The emperor replied: "My great principle with you is already fixed—how could there be accepting in success and abandoning in defeat!
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor replied: "Our great bond is fixed—how accept in success and abandon in defeat!

sentences.zh: 今高氏有使求和，朕亦更思偃武。

translations.literal: "Now the Gao house has envoys seeking peace—I too again think to still arms.
translations.idiomatic: "Now the Gao send envoys for peace—I too think to still arms.

sentences.zh: 進退之宜，國有常制。

translations.literal: "Advance and retreat have their proper measure—the state has constant rules.
translations.idiomatic: "Advance and retreat have their rules.

sentences.zh: 公但清靜自居，無勞慮也！

translations.literal: "You need only dwell in quiet—no need for anxious thought!
translations.idiomatic: "Dwell in quiet—do not worry!

sentences.zh: 」景又啟曰：「臣今蓄糧聚眾，秣馬潛戈，指日計期，克清趙、魏，不容軍出無名，故願以陛下為主耳。

translations.literal: " Jing again memorialized: "Your servant now stores grain and gathers masses, feeds horses and hides blades; counting days and fixing the term, he will clear Zhao and Wei; armies cannot march without name—therefore he wishes to take Your Majesty as lord.
translations.idiomatic: " Jing memorialized again: "I store grain, gather men, feed horses, hide blades. On the fixed day I will clear Zhao and Wei. Armies need a name—I wish to take Your Majesty as lord.

sentences.zh: 今陛下棄臣遐外，南北復通，將恐微臣之身，不免高氏之手。

translations.literal: "Now Your Majesty casts your servant far off, north and south join again—I fear your servant's slight person will not escape the Gao hand.
translations.idiomatic: "Now you cast me far off while north and south join again—I fear I will not escape the Gao.

sentences.zh: 」上又報曰：「朕為萬乘之主，豈可失信於一物！

translations.literal: " The emperor again replied: "I as lord of ten thousand chariots—how can I break faith over one thing!
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor replied again: "I am lord of ten thousand chariots—how break faith over one thing!

sentences.zh: 想公深得此心，不勞復有啟也。

translations.literal: "I think you deeply grasp this heart—no need for further memorials.
translations.idiomatic: "I think you grasp this—no more memorials needed.

sentences.zh: 景乃詐為鄴中書，求以貞陽侯易景；

translations.literal: Jing then forged a letter from Ye and asked to exchange Marquis of Zhenyang for Jing;
translations.idiomatic: Jing forged a letter from Ye asking to exchange Marquis of Zhenyang for himself;

sentences.zh: 上將許之。

translations.literal: the emperor was about to grant it.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor was about to agree.

sentences.zh: 舍人傅岐曰：「侯景以窮歸義，棄之不祥；

translations.literal: Attendant Fu Qi said: "Hou Jing in extremity came in allegiance—to cast him off is ill fortune;
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Fu Qi said: "Hou Jing came in allegiance at extremity—to cast him off is ill fortune;

sentences.zh: 且百戰之餘，寧肯束手受縶！

translations.literal: "moreover after a hundred battles, would he willingly bind his hands and accept bonds!
translations.idiomatic: "and after a hundred battles, would he bind his hands!

sentences.zh: 」謝舉、朱異曰：「景奔敗之將，一使之力耳。

translations.literal: " Xie Ju and Zhu Yi said: "Jing is a fleeing defeated general—one envoy's strength is enough.
translations.idiomatic: " Xie Ju and Zhu Yi said: "Jing is a fleeing defeated general—one envoy is enough.

sentences.zh: 」上從之，復書曰：「貞陽旦至，侯景夕返。

translations.literal: " The emperor followed them and replied: "Zhenyang arrives at dawn, Hou Jing returns at dusk.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed and replied: "Zhenyang at dawn, Hou Jing at dusk.

sentences.zh: 」景謂左右曰：「我固知吳老公薄心腸！

translations.literal: " Jing told those beside him: "I knew all along the old Wu lord has a thin heart!
translations.idiomatic: " Jing told his men: "I knew the old Wu lord has a thin heart!

sentences.zh: 」王偉說景曰：「今坐聽亦死，舉大事亦死，唯王圖之！

translations.literal: " Wang Wei urged Jing: "Now sit and listen—you die; raise a great affair—you die; only Your Highness must decide!
translations.idiomatic: " Wang Wei urged Jing: "Sit and listen—you die. Raise a great affair—you die. Only decide, Your Highness!

sentences.zh: 」於是始為反計，屬城居民，悉召募為軍士，輒停責市估及田租，百姓子女，悉以配將士。

translations.literal: " Then he first formed plans of rebellion, calling up dependent-city residents as soldiers, halting market taxes and field rents, and assigning commoners' sons and daughters entirely to officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: " Then he began rebellion plans: conscripted dependent-city residents, halted market taxes and field rents, and assigned commoners' sons and daughters to officers.

sentences.zh: 三月，癸巳，東魏以太尉襄城王旭為大司馬，開府儀同三司高岳為太尉。

translations.literal: In the third month, on guisi, Eastern Wei made Grand Commandant Prince of Xiangcheng Xu Grand Marshal and Acting Three Excellencies Gao Yue Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on guisi, Eastern Wei made Grand Commandant Prince Xu of Xiangcheng grand marshal and Gao Yue grand commandant.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，大將軍澄南臨黎陽，自虎牢濟河至洛陽。

translations.literal: On xinhai, Grand General Cheng went south to Lin Yang, crossed the Yellow River from Hulao, and reached Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Grand General Gao Cheng went south to Lin Yang, crossed the Yellow River from Hulao, and reached Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 魏同軌防長史裴寬與東魏將彭樂等戰，為樂所擒，澄禮遇甚厚，寬得間逃歸。

translations.literal: Western Wei Tonggui Defense Chief of Staff Pei Kuan fought Eastern Wei General Peng Yue and others, was captured by Yue; Cheng treated him with great honor and Pei Kuan found an opening and escaped back.
translations.idiomatic: Pei Kuan, Western Wei Tonggui defense chief of staff, fought Eastern Wei general Peng Yue, was captured; Gao Cheng honored him richly and Pei Kuan escaped.

sentences.zh: 澄由太行返晉陽。

translations.literal: Cheng returned to Jinyang by the Taihang route.
translations.idiomatic: Gao Cheng returned to Jinyang by the Taihang route.

sentences.zh: 屈獠洞斬李賁，傳首建康。

translations.literal: Quliao Cave beheaded Li Ben and sent the head to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Quliao Cave beheaded Li Ben and sent the head to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 賁兄天寶遁入九真，收餘兵二萬圍愛州，交州司馬陳霸先帥眾討平之。

translations.literal: Ben's elder brother Tianbao fled into Jiuzhen, gathered remnant troops of twenty thousand, and besieged Aizhou; Jiaozhou Marshal Chen Baxian led troops and suppressed him.
translations.idiomatic: Ben's brother Tianbao fled to Jiuzhen, gathered twenty thousand remnant troops, and besieged Aizhou; Jiaozhou marshal Chen Baxian suppressed him.

sentences.zh: 詔以霸先為西江督護、高要太守、督七郡諸軍事。

translations.literal: An edict made Baxian Protector of the Western River, Administrator of Gaoyao, and commander of military affairs in seven commanderies.
translations.idiomatic: An edict made Baxian Protector of the Western River, administrator of Gaoyao, and commander of military affairs in seven commanderies.

sentences.zh: 夏，四月，甲子，東魏吏部令史張永和等偽假人官，事覺，糾檢、首者六萬餘人。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, on jiazi, Eastern Wei Ministry of Personnel clerks Zhang Yonghe and others falsely assumed others' offices; the matter was exposed—those investigated and who informed numbered more than sixty thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, on jiazi, Eastern Wei ministry of personnel clerks Zhang Yonghe and others forged appointments; exposed, those investigated and who informed exceeded sixty thousand.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，東魏遣太尉高岳、行台慕容紹宗、大都督劉豐生等將步騎十萬攻魏王思政於穎川。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Eastern Wei sent Grand Commandant Gao Yue, Field Secretariat Murong Shaozong, Grand Commander Liu Fengsheng, and others with a hundred thousand foot and horse to attack Western Wei's Wang Sizheng at Yingchuan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Eastern Wei sent Grand Commandant Gao Yue, field secretariat Murong Shaozong, grand commander Liu Fengsheng, and a hundred thousand foot and horse against Wang Sizheng at Yingchuan.

sentences.zh: 思政命臥鼓偃旗，若無人者。

translations.literal: Sizheng ordered drums laid and banners lowered as if no one were there.
translations.idiomatic: Sizheng ordered drums laid and banners lowered as if empty.

sentences.zh: 岳恃其眾，四面陵城。

translations.literal: Yue relied on his numbers and pressed the city on four sides.
translations.idiomatic: Yue relied on his numbers and pressed the city on four sides.

sentences.zh: 思政選驍勇開門出戰，岳兵敗走。

translations.literal: Sizheng chose the fierce and brave, opened the gates, and went out to fight; Yue's army was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Sizheng chose the fierce, opened the gates, and fought; Yue's army fled.

sentences.zh: 岳更築土山，晝夜攻之，思政隨方拒守，奪其土山，置樓堞以助防守。

translations.literal: Yue again built earthen hills and attacked day and night; Sizheng resisted on every side, seized their hills, and set parapets to aid defense.
translations.idiomatic: Yue built earthen hills and attacked day and night; Sizheng resisted, seized the hills, and set parapets.

sentences.zh: 五月，魏以丞相泰為太師，廣陵王欣為太傅，李弼為大宗伯，趙貴為大司寇，於謹為大司空。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, Western Wei made Chancellor Tai Grand Preceptor, Prince of Guangling Xin Grand Tutor, Li Bi Grand Herald, Zhao Gui Grand Judge, and Yu Jin Grand Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Western Wei made Yuwen Tai Grand Preceptor, Prince Xin of Guangling Grand Tutor, Li Bi Grand Herald, Zhao Gui Grand Judge, and Yu Jin Grand Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 太師泰奉太子巡撫西境，登隴，至原州，歷北長城，東趣五原，至蒲州，聞魏主不豫而還。

translations.literal: Grand Preceptor Tai accompanied the crown prince on a tour of the western marches, ascended Long, reached Yuanzhou, passed the northern Long Wall, turned east toward Wuyuan, reached Puzhou, heard the Wei ruler was unwell and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Preceptor Yuwen Tai toured the western marches with the crown prince, ascended Long, reached Yuanzhou, passed the northern Long Wall, turned east to Wuyuan, reached Puzhou, heard the Wei ruler was ill and returned.

sentences.zh: 及至，已癒，泰還華州。

translations.literal: When he arrived, the ruler had recovered; Tai returned to Huazhou.
translations.idiomatic: When he arrived the ruler had recovered; Yuwen Tai returned to Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 上遣建康令謝挺、散騎常侍徐陵等聘於東魏，復修前好。

translations.literal: The emperor sent Jiankang Magistrate Xie Ting, Palace Attendant Xu Ling, and others on a friendly mission to Eastern Wei, renewing the former friendship.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Jiankang magistrate Xie Ting, palace attendant Xu Ling, and others to Eastern Wei to renew friendship.

sentences.zh: 陵，手離之子也。

translations.literal: Ling was the son of Shouli.
translations.idiomatic: Ling was the son of Xu Shouli.

sentences.zh: 六月，東魏大將軍澄巡北邊。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Eastern Wei Grand General Cheng toured the northern border.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Eastern Wei grand general Gao Cheng toured the northern border.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，庚寅朔，日有食之。

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, on the first day gengyin, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, on new year's day gengyin, the sun was eclipsed.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，東魏大將軍澄朝於鄴。

translations.literal: On yimao, Eastern Wei Grand General Cheng entered court at Ye.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Eastern Wei grand general Gao Cheng entered court at Ye.

sentences.zh: 以道士多偽濫，始罷南郊道壇。

translations.literal: Because Daoist priests were mostly false and corrupt, the southern suburb Daoist altar was first abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Because Daoist priests were mostly false, the southern suburb Daoist altar was abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月，庚寅，澄還晉陽，遣尚書辛術帥諸將略江、淮之北，凡獲二十三州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on gengyin, Cheng returned to Jinyang and sent Minister of the Masters of Writing Xin Shu with generals to raid north of the Jiang and Huai—twenty-three provinces were taken in all.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengyin, Gao Cheng returned to Jinyang and sent minister Xin Shu with generals to raid north of the Jiang and Huai—twenty-three provinces in all.

sentences.zh: 侯景自至壽陽，徵求無已，朝廷未嘗拒絕。

translations.literal: From the time Hou Jing reached Shouchun, his demands were endless and the court never refused.
translations.idiomatic: From the time Hou Jing reached Shouchun his demands were endless and the court never refused.

sentences.zh: 景請娶於王、謝，上曰：「王、謝門高非偶，可於朱、張以下訪之。

translations.literal: Jing asked to marry into the Wang and Xie clans; the emperor said: "The Wang and Xie gates are too high—not a match; you may inquire below the Zhu and Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: Jing asked to marry into the Wang and Xie clans. The emperor said: "Wang and Xie are too lofty a match. Look below Zhu and Zhang.

sentences.zh: 」景恚曰：「會將吳兒女配奴！

translations.literal: " Jing said in rage: "I will yet mate Wu girls to slaves!
translations.idiomatic: " Jing raged: "I will mate Wu girls to slaves!

sentences.zh: 」又啟求錦萬匹為軍人作袍，中領軍朱異議以青布給之。

translations.literal: " He again memorialized asking for ten thousand lengths of brocade to make robes for soldiers; Central Palace Guard Commander Zhu Yi deliberated giving green cloth instead.
translations.idiomatic: " He asked for ten thousand lengths of brocade for soldiers' robes; Central Palace Guard Commander Zhu Yi proposed green cloth instead.

sentences.zh: 又以台所給仗多不能精，啟請東冶鍛工，欲更營造，敕並給之。

translations.literal: Also because many of the arms given from the capital were not fine, he memorialized asking for Eastern Forge smiths to rebuild them—an edict granted all.
translations.idiomatic: Because many arms from the capital were poor, he asked for Eastern Forge smiths to rebuild them—an edict granted all.

sentences.zh: 景以安北將軍夏侯夔之子譒為長史，徐思玉為司馬，譒遂去「夏」稱「侯」，托為族子。

translations.literal: Jing made Northern Pacification General Xiahou Kui's son Zi chief of staff and Xu Siyu marshal; Zi then dropped Xia and called himself Hou, claiming to be a clan nephew.
translations.idiomatic: Jing made Northern Pacification General Xiahou Kui's son Zi chief of staff and Xu Siyu marshal. Zi dropped Xia, called himself Hou, and claimed to be a clan nephew.

sentences.zh: 上既不用景言，與東魏和親，是後景表疏稍稍悖慢；

translations.literal: The emperor having not followed Jing's words and having made peace with Eastern Wei, thereafter Jing's memorials gradually grew insolent;
translations.idiomatic: The emperor having ignored Jing and made peace with Eastern Wei, Jing's memorials grew insolent;

sentences.zh: 又聞徐陵等使魏，反謀益甚。

translations.literal: hearing Xu Ling and others were envoys to Wei, his rebel plotting grew all the more.
translations.idiomatic: hearing Xu Ling was envoy to Wei, his plotting grew worse.

sentences.zh: 元貞知景有異志，累啟還朝。

translations.literal: Yuan Zhen knew Jing had a different intent and repeatedly memorialized to return to court.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Zhen knew Jing had other designs and repeatedly asked to return to court.

sentences.zh: 景謂曰：「河北事雖不果，江南何慮失之，何不小忍！

translations.literal: Jing said to him: "Though the Hebei affair did not succeed, what worry is there of losing Jiangnan—why not bear a little!
translations.idiomatic: Jing told him: "Hebei failed, but what worry is Jiangnan—why not bear a little!

sentences.zh: 」貞懼，逃歸建康，具以事聞；

translations.literal: " Zhen feared, fled back to Jiankang, and fully reported the matter;
translations.idiomatic: " Zhen, afraid, fled to Jiankang and reported everything;

sentences.zh: 上以貞為始興內史，亦不問景。

translations.literal: the emperor made Zhen Administrator of Shixing and also did not question Jing.
translations.idiomatic: the emperor made Zhen administrator of Shixing and did not question Jing.

sentences.zh: 臨賀王正德，所至貪暴不法，屢得罪於上，由是憤恨，陰養死士，儲米積貨，幸國家有變；

translations.literal: Prince of Linhe Zhengde, wherever he went was greedy, violent, and lawless; he repeatedly offended the emperor and therefore nursed resentment, secretly keeping death-dealing men, storing rice and piling goods, hoping the state would have change;
translations.idiomatic: Prince Zhengde of Linhe was greedy and lawless wherever he went, repeatedly offended the emperor, nursed resentment, secretly kept death-dealing men, stored grain and goods, and hoped for upheaval;

sentences.zh: 景知之。

translations.literal: Jing knew it.
translations.idiomatic: Jing knew.

sentences.zh: 正德在北與徐思玉相知，景遣思玉致箋於正德曰：「今天子年尊，奸臣亂國。

translations.literal: Zhengde in the north had known Xu Siyu; Jing sent Siyu with a letter to Zhengde: "Today the Son of Heaven is aged and wicked ministers throw the state into chaos.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde had known Xu Siyu in the north. Jing sent Siyu with a letter: "The Son of Heaven is aged and wicked ministers ruin the realm.

sentences.zh: 以景觀之，計日禍敗。

translations.literal: "In Jing's view, disaster and defeat are counted by days.
translations.idiomatic: "In my view disaster comes within days.

sentences.zh: 大王屬當儲貳，中被廢黜，四海業業，歸心大王。

translations.literal: "Your Highness by right should be heir apparent, yet was deposed mid-course; the four seas tremble and hearts turn to Your Highness.
translations.idiomatic: "You should be heir yet were deposed; the realm trembles and hearts turn to you.

sentences.zh: 景雖不敏，實思自效。

translations.literal: "Though Jing is not clever, he truly wishes to offer himself.
translations.idiomatic: "I am not clever, but I wish to serve.

sentences.zh: 願王允副蒼生，鑒斯誠款！

translations.literal: "May Your Highness grant the people's wish and discern this sincere pledge!"
translations.idiomatic: "Grant the people's wish and see my sincerity!"

sentences.zh: 」正德大喜曰：「侯公之意，暗與吾同，天授我也！

translations.literal: " Zhengde was greatly pleased and said: "Lord Hou's intent secretly matches mine—Heaven grants it!
translations.idiomatic: " Zhengde was delighted: "Lord Hou's heart matches mine in secret—Heaven grants it!

sentences.zh: 」報之曰：「朝廷之事，如公所言。

translations.literal: " He replied: "Court affairs are as you say.
translations.idiomatic: " He replied: "Court affairs are as you say.

sentences.zh: 僕之有心，為日久矣。

translations.literal: "Your servant's intent has been long.
translations.idiomatic: "My intent is old.

sentences.zh: 今僕為其內，公為其外，何有不濟！

translations.literal: "Now your servant within, you without—what could fail!"
translations.idiomatic: "I within, you without—what could fail!"

sentences.zh: 機事在速，今其時矣。

translations.literal: "The critical affair lies in speed—now is the hour.
translations.idiomatic: "Speed is everything—now is the hour.

sentences.zh: 鄱陽王范密啟景謀反。

translations.literal: Prince of Poyang Fan secretly memorialized that Jing plotted rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Fan of Poyang secretly reported Jing's rebellion.

sentences.zh: 時上以邊事專委朱異，動靜皆關之，異以為必無此理。

translations.literal: At the time the emperor had wholly entrusted border affairs to Zhu Yi; every move passed through him; Yi thought it surely could not be.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had wholly entrusted border affairs to Zhu Yi; Yi thought it impossible.

sentences.zh: 上報范曰：「景孤危寄命，譬如嬰兒仰人乳哺，以此事勢，安能反乎！

translations.literal: The emperor replied to Fan: "Jing is isolated and perilous, his life entrusted elsewhere—like an infant looking up for another's milk; with this situation, how could he rebel!
translations.idiomatic: The emperor replied: "Jing is isolated, his life in others' hands—like an infant at the breast. How could he rebel!

sentences.zh: 」范重陳之曰：「不早剪撲，禍及生民。

translations.literal: " Fan again stated it: "If not cut down early, calamity will reach the living people.
translations.idiomatic: " Fan pressed: "Fail to cut him down early and the people will suffer.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「朝廷自有處分，不須汝深憂也。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "The court has its own disposition—no need for your deep worry.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "The court will handle it—no need for deep worry.

sentences.zh: 」范復請自以合肥之眾討之，上不許。

translations.literal: " Fan again asked to lead the Hefei forces himself to suppress him; the emperor did not permit.
translations.idiomatic: " Fan asked to lead Hefei's forces himself; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 朱異謂范使曰：「鄱陽王遂不許朝廷有一客！

translations.literal: Zhu Yi told Fan's messenger: "Does Prince of Poyang not even allow the court one guest!
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Yi told Fan's messenger: "Will Prince of Poyang not even leave the court one guest!

sentences.zh: 」自是范啟，異不復為通。

translations.literal: " From then Fan's memorials Yi no longer passed through.
translations.idiomatic: " From then Fan's memorials Yi no longer forwarded.

sentences.zh: 景邀羊鴉仁同反，鴉仁執其使以聞。

translations.literal: Jing invited Yang Yaren to rebel together; Yaren seized his messenger and reported.
translations.idiomatic: Jing invited Yang Yaren to rebel; Yaren seized the messenger and reported.

sentences.zh: 異曰：「景數百叛虜，何能為！

translations.literal: Yi said: "Jing is a few hundred rebel captives—what can he do!
translations.idiomatic: Yi said: "Jing is a few hundred rebel captives—what can he do!

sentences.zh: 」敕以使者付建康獄，俄解遣之。

translations.literal: " An edict handed the messenger to Jiankang prison; soon he was released and sent away.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict put the messenger in Jiankang prison; soon he was released.

sentences.zh: 景益無所憚，啟上曰：「若臣事是實，應罹國憲；

translations.literal: Jing grew all the more unrestrained and memorialized the emperor: "If your servant's affair is true, he should suffer the state's punishment;
translations.idiomatic: Jing grew bolder and memorialized: "If I am guilty, let me suffer the state's law;

sentences.zh: 如蒙照察，請戮鴉仁！

translations.literal: "if I receive your gracious scrutiny, I ask to execute Yaren!
translations.idiomatic: "if you investigate graciously, execute Yaren!

sentences.zh: 」景又上言：「高澄狡猾，寧可全信！

translations.literal: " Jing again memorialized: "Gao Cheng is crafty—how can he be wholly trusted!
translations.idiomatic: " Jing memorialized again: "Gao Cheng is crafty—how trust him wholly!

sentences.zh: 陛下納其詭語，求與連和，臣亦竊所笑也。

translations.literal: Your Majesty accepts his deceitful words and seeks alliance with him—your servant too privately laughs at this.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty accepts his deceitful words and seeks alliance with him—I too have been privately laughing at this.

sentences.zh: 臣寧堪粉骨，投命仇門，乞江西一境，受臣控督。

translations.literal: Your servant would rather be ground to bone powder and throw his life at the enemy's gate, begging one region west of the river under my control and supervision.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant would rather be ground to powder and throw his life at the enemy's gate—grant me one region west of the river to hold and govern.

sentences.zh: 如其不許，即帥甲騎，臨江上，向閩、越。

translations.literal: If this is not granted, I shall then lead armored cavalry to the river's edge and march toward Min and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: If this is not granted, I shall lead armored cavalry to the river's edge and march toward Min and Yue.

sentences.zh: 非唯朝廷自恥，亦是三公旰食。

translations.literal: Not only would the court be shamed, but the Three Dukes would eat late at their meals.
translations.idiomatic: The court would be shamed, and the Three Dukes would lose their sleep over it.

sentences.zh: 」上使朱異宣語答景使曰：「譬如貧家，畜十客、五客，尚能得意；

translations.literal: " The emperor had Zhu Yi deliver a proclamation answering Jing's envoy: "It is like a poor household keeping ten or five guests and still being satisfied;
translations.idiomatic: " The Liang emperor had Zhu Yi deliver a proclamation answering Hou Jing's envoy: "It is like a poor household keeping ten or five guests and still being satisfied;

sentences.zh: 朕唯有一客，致有忿言，亦朕之失也。

translations.literal: I have only one guest, yet there are angry words—this too is my failing.
translations.idiomatic: I have only one guest, yet there are angry words—this too is my failing.

sentences.zh: 」益加賞賜錦彩錢布，信使相望。

translations.literal: " He increased gifts of brocade, silk, money, and cloth; envoys came and went in sight of one another.
translations.idiomatic: " He increased gifts of brocade, silk, money, and cloth; envoys came and went without pause.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，景反於壽陽，以誅中領軍朱異、少府卿徐驎、太子右衛率陸驗、制局監周石珍為名。

translations.literal: On wuxu, Jing rebelled at Shouyang, naming as his cause the execution of Central Army Commander Zhu Yi, Minister of the Palace Treasury Xu Lin, Right Commandant of the Crown Prince's Guard Lu Yan, and Director of the Bureau of Manufactures Zhou Shizhen.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Hou Jing rebelled at Shouyang, naming as his cause the execution of Central Army Commander Zhu Yi, Minister of the Palace Treasury Xu Lin, Right Commandant of the Crown Prince's Guard Lu Yan, and Director of the Bureau of Manufactures Zhou Shizhen.

sentences.zh: 異等皆以奸佞驕貪，蔽主弄權，為時人所疾，故景托以興兵。

translations.literal: Yi and the others were all hated by the age for flattery, arrogance, and greed—screening the ruler and manipulating power—so Jing used them as a pretext for raising troops.
translations.idiomatic: Yi and the others were hated throughout the realm for flattery, arrogance, and greed—screening the ruler and manipulating power—so Hou Jing used them as a pretext for raising troops.

sentences.zh: 驎、驗，吳郡人；

translations.literal: Lin and Yan were from Wu commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Lin and Yan were from Wu commandery.

sentences.zh: 石珍，丹楊人。

translations.literal: Shizhen was from Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: Shizhen was from Danyang.

sentences.zh: 驎、驗迭為少府丞，以苛刻為務，百賈怨之，異尤與之暱，世人謂之「三蠹」。

translations.literal: Lin and Yan alternated as assistants in the Palace Treasury, making harshness their business; merchants hated them, Yi was especially intimate with them, and the world called them the Three Vermin.
translations.idiomatic: Lin and Yan alternated as assistants in the Palace Treasury, making harshness their business; merchants hated them, Zhu Yi was especially close to them, and the world called them the Three Vermin.

sentences.zh: 司農卿傅岐，鯁直士也，嘗謂異曰：「卿任參國鈞，榮寵如此。

translations.literal: Minister of Agriculture Fu Qi was a stern, upright man; he once said to Yi, "You share in governing the state and enjoy such honor and favor.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Agriculture Fu Qi was a stern, upright man; he once said to Zhu Yi, "You share in governing the state and enjoy such honor and favor.

sentences.zh: 比日所聞，鄙穢狼藉，若使聖主發悟，欲免得乎！

translations.literal: What I have heard these last days is filth and disarray—if the sage ruler awakens, do you think you will escape punishment!
translations.idiomatic: What I have heard these last days is filth and disarray—if the sage ruler awakens, do you think you will escape punishment!

sentences.zh: 」異曰：「外間謗黷，知之久矣。

translations.literal: " Yi said, "Slander from outside—I have long known of it.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhu Yi said, "Slander from outside—I have long known of it.

sentences.zh: 心苟無愧，何恤人言！

translations.literal: If the heart is without guilt, why fear men's words!
translations.idiomatic: If the heart is without guilt, why fear men's words!

sentences.zh: 」岐謂人曰：「朱彥和將死矣。

translations.literal: " Fu Qi told others, "Zhu Yanhe is about to die.
translations.idiomatic: " Fu Qi told others, "Zhu Yanhe is about to die.

sentences.zh: 恃諂以求容，肆辯以拒諫，聞難而不懼，知惡而不改，天奪其鑒，其能久乎！

translations.literal: Relying on flattery to seek acceptance, unrestrained in argument to reject remonstrance—hearing difficulty without fear, knowing evil without change; Heaven has taken his mirror—how long can he last!
translations.idiomatic: Relying on flattery to seek acceptance, unrestrained in argument to reject remonstrance—hearing difficulty without fear, knowing evil without change; Heaven has taken his mirror—how long can he last!

sentences.zh: 景西攻馬頭，遣其將宋子仙東攻木柵，執戍主曹璆等，上聞之，笑曰：「是何能為！

translations.literal: Jing attacked Matao in the west and sent his general Song Zixian east to attack the wooden palisade, capturing garrison commanders including Cao Qiu; when the emperor heard, he laughed and said, "What can they do!
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing attacked Matao in the west and sent his general Song Zixian east to attack the wooden palisade, capturing garrison commanders including Cao Qiu; when the Liang emperor heard, he laughed and said, "What can they do!

sentences.zh: 吾折棰笞之。

translations.literal: I shall break a rod and whip them.
translations.idiomatic: I'll break a rod and whip them.

sentences.zh: 」敕購斬景者，封三千戶公，除州刺史。

translations.literal: " He ordered that whoever killed Jing would be enfeoffed as a duke with three thousand households and made Inspector of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered that whoever killed Hou Jing would be enfeoffed as a duke with three thousand households and made Inspector of Chu.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，詔以合州刺史鄱陽王范為南道都督，北徐州刺史封山侯正表為北道都督，司州刺史柳仲禮為西道都督，通直散騎常侍裴之高為東道都督，以侍中、開府儀同三司邵陵王綸持節董督眾軍以討景。

translations.literal: On jiachen, an edict made Hezhou Inspector Prince Fan of Poyang commander of the southern route, North Xuzhou Inspector Marquis Zhengbiao of Fengshan commander of the northern route, Si province Inspector Liu Zhongli commander of the western route, Direct Attendant Pei Zhigao commander of the eastern route, and Palace Attendant Prince Lun of Shaoling, holding imperial credentials, to oversee all forces against Jing.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, an edict made Hezhou Inspector Prince Fan of Poyang commander of the southern route, North Xuzhou Inspector Marquis Zhengbiao of Fengshan commander of the northern route, Si province Inspector Liu Zhongli commander of the western route, Direct Attendant Pei Zhigao commander of the eastern route, and Palace Attendant Prince Lun of Shaoling, holding imperial credentials, to oversee all forces against Hou Jing.

sentences.zh: 正表，宏之子；

translations.literal: Zhengbiao was Hong's son.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengbiao was Hong's son.

sentences.zh: 仲禮，慶遠之孫；

translations.literal: Zhongli was the grandson of Qingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongli was the grandson of Qingyuan.

sentences.zh: 之高，邃之兄子也。

translations.literal: Zhigao was a nephew of Sui's elder brother.
translations.idiomatic: Zhigao was a nephew of Sui's elder brother.

sentences.zh: 九月，東魏濮陽武公婁昭卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, Lou Zhao, Duke of Puyang of Eastern Wei, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, Lou Zhao, Duke of Puyang of Eastern Wei, died.

sentences.zh: 侯景聞台軍討之，問策於王偉。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing heard imperial troops were coming against him, he asked Wang Wei for counsel.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing heard imperial troops were coming against him, he asked Wang Wei for counsel.

sentences.zh: 偉曰：「邵陵若至，彼眾我寡，必為所困。

translations.literal: Wei said, "If Prince Lun of Shaoling arrives, they will outnumber us—we are sure to be trapped.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Wei said, "If Prince Lun of Shaoling arrives, they will outnumber us—we are sure to be trapped.

sentences.zh: 不如棄淮南，決志東向，帥輕騎直掩建康；

translations.literal: Better abandon Huainan, resolve to turn east, lead light cavalry in a direct strike on Jiankang;
translations.idiomatic: Better abandon Huainan, resolve to turn east, and lead light cavalry in a direct strike on Jiankang;

sentences.zh: 臨賀反其內，大王攻其外，天下不足定也。

translations.literal: Prince Linhe rebels within, Your Highness attacks without—the realm is easily settled.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Linhe rebels within, Your Highness attacks without—the realm is easily settled.

sentences.zh: 兵貴拙速，宜即進路。

translations.literal: Speed matters more than finesse in war; we should march at once.
translations.idiomatic: Speed matters more than finesse in war; we should march at once.

sentences.zh: 」景乃留外弟中軍大都督王顯貴守壽陽；

translations.literal: " Jing then left his maternal cousin, Central Army Grand Commander Wang Xiangui, to hold Shouyang;
translations.idiomatic: " Hou Jing then left his maternal cousin, Central Army Grand Commander Wang Xiangui, to hold Shouyang;

sentences.zh: 癸未，詐稱遊獵，出壽陽，人不之覺。

translations.literal: on guimwei, feigning a hunting excursion, he left Shouyang without anyone noticing.
translations.idiomatic: on guimwei, feigning a hunting excursion, he left Shouyang without anyone noticing.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，庚寅，景揚聲趣合肥，而實襲譙州，助防董紹先開城降之。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on gengyin, Jing announced he was heading for Hefei but actually struck Qiao province; Assistant Defender Dong Shaoxian opened the gates and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on gengyin, Hou Jing announced he was heading for Hefei but actually struck Qiao province; Assistant Defender Dong Shaoxian opened the gates and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 執刺史豐城侯泰。

translations.literal: They seized Inspector Marquis Tai of Fengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: They seized Inspector Marquis Tai of Fengcheng.

sentences.zh: 泰，范之弟也，先為中書舍人，傾財以事時要，超授譙州刺史。

translations.literal: Tai was Fan's younger brother; formerly a Palace Secretary, he spent fortunes currying favor with powerful men and was abruptly made Inspector of Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: Tai was Fan's younger brother; formerly a Palace Secretary, he spent fortunes currying favor with powerful men and was abruptly made Inspector of Qiao.

sentences.zh: 至州，遍發民丁，使擔腰輿、扇、繖等物，不限士庶；

translations.literal: On reaching his post, he conscripted men everywhere to carry palanquins, fans, parasols, and the like, with no distinction between gentry and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On reaching his post, he conscripted men everywhere to carry palanquins, fans, parasols, and the like, with no distinction between gentry and commoners.

sentences.zh: 恥為之者，重加杖責，多輸財者，即縱免之，由是人皆思亂。

translations.literal: Those who refused were harshly beaten; those who paid heavily were released—so everyone wished for disorder.
translations.idiomatic: Those who refused were harshly beaten; those who paid heavily were released—so everyone wished for disorder.

sentences.zh: 及侯景至，人無戰心，故敗。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing arrived, no one would fight, and they were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing arrived, no one would fight, and they were defeated.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔遣寧遠將軍王質帥眾三千巡江防遏。

translations.literal: On gengzi, an edict sent General Wang Zhi with three thousand men to patrol the river and block the advance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, an edict sent General Wang Zhi with three thousand men to patrol the river and block the advance.

sentences.zh: 景攻歷陽太守莊鐵，丁未，鐵以城降，因說景曰：「國家承平歲久，人不習戰，聞大王舉兵，內外震駭。

translations.literal: Jing attacked Liyang Administrator Zhuang Tie; on dingwei, Tie surrendered the city and urged Jing, saying, "The state has been at peace so long that men no longer know war; when they hear Your Highness has raised arms, court and country alike are terrified.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing attacked Liyang Administrator Zhuang Tie; on dingwei, Tie surrendered the city and urged him, saying, "The state has been at peace so long that men no longer know war; when they hear Your Highness has raised arms, court and country alike are terrified.

sentences.zh: 宜乘此際速趨建康，可兵不血刃而成大功。

translations.literal: Seize this moment and rush on Jiankang—you can win a great victory without blood on the blades.
translations.idiomatic: Seize this moment and rush on Jiankang—you can win a great victory without blood on the blades.

sentences.zh: 若使朝廷徐得為備，內外小安，遣羸兵千人直據採石，大王雖有精甲百萬，不得濟矣。

translations.literal: If the court slowly prepares, inner and outer calm return, and a thousand weak troops hold Caishi, Your Highness may have a million fine armored men and still not cross.
translations.idiomatic: If the court slowly prepares, inner and outer calm return, and a thousand weak troops hold Caishi, Your Highness may have a million fine armored men and still not cross.

sentences.zh: 」景乃留儀同三司田英、郭駱守歷陽，以鐵為導，引兵臨江。

translations.literal: " Jing then left Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes Tian Ying and Guo Luo to hold Liyang, made Tie his guide, and led his army to the river.
translations.idiomatic: " Hou Jing then left Tian Ying and Guo Luo, Equal in Honor to the Three Dukes, to hold Liyang, made Tie his guide, and led his army to the river.

sentences.zh: 江上鎮戍相次啟聞。

translations.literal: River garrisons sent reports one after another.
translations.idiomatic: River garrisons sent reports one after another.

sentences.zh: 上問討景之策於都官尚書羊侃，侃請「以二千人急據採石，令邵陵王襲取壽陽；

translations.literal: The emperor asked Minister of Justice Yang Kan for a plan against Jing; Kan urged rushing two thousand men to hold Caishi and having Prince Lun of Shaoling strike Shouyang;
translations.idiomatic: The Liang emperor asked Minister of Justice Yang Kan for a plan against Hou Jing; Yang Kan urged rushing two thousand men to hold Caishi and having Prince Lun of Shaoling strike Shouyang;

sentences.zh: 使景進不得前，退失巢穴，烏合之眾，自然瓦解。

translations.literal: Jing could neither advance nor retreat to his lair; his rabble would collapse of itself.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing could neither advance nor retreat to his lair; his rabble would collapse of itself.

sentences.zh: 」朱異曰：「景必無渡江之志。

translations.literal: " Zhu Yi said, "Jing surely has no intention of crossing the river.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhu Yi said, "Hou Jing surely has no intention of crossing the river.

sentences.zh: 」遂寢其議。

translations.literal: " The proposal was shelved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was shelved.

sentences.zh: 侃曰：「今茲敗矣！

translations.literal: Kan said, "We are defeated already!
translations.idiomatic: Yang Kan said, "We are defeated already!

sentences.zh: 戊申，以臨賀王正德為平北將軍、都督京師諸軍事，屯丹楊郡。

translations.literal: On wushen, Prince Zhengde of Linhe was made General Who Pacifies the North and commander of capital forces, stationed in Danyang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Prince Zhengde of Linhe was made General Who Pacifies the North and commander of capital forces, stationed in Danyang commandery.

sentences.zh: 正德遣大船數十艘，詐稱載荻，密以濟景。

translations.literal: Zhengde sent dozens of large ships, claiming they carried reeds, secretly to ferry Jing across.
translations.idiomatic: Zhengde sent dozens of large ships, claiming they carried reeds, secretly to ferry Hou Jing across.

sentences.zh: 景將濟，慮王質為梗，使諜視之。

translations.literal: As Jing prepared to cross, fearing Wang Zhi would block him, he sent spies to watch.
translations.idiomatic: As Hou Jing prepared to cross, fearing Wang Zhi would block him, he sent spies to watch.

sentences.zh: 會臨川大守陳昕啟稱：「採石急須重鎮，王質水軍輕弱，恐不能濟。

translations.literal: Just then Linchuan Administrator Chen Xin memorialized, saying, "Caishi urgently needs a strong garrison; Wang Zhi's river forces are light and weak—they may not hold.
translations.idiomatic: Just then Linchuan Administrator Chen Xin memorialized, saying, "Caishi urgently needs a strong garrison; Wang Zhi's river forces are light and weak—they may not hold.

sentences.zh: 」上以昕為雲旗將軍，代質戍採石，征質知丹楊尹事。

translations.literal: " The emperor made Xin General of the Cloud Banner, replaced Zhi at Caishi, and summoned Zhi to serve as Governor of Danyang.
translations.idiomatic: " The Liang emperor made Xin General of the Cloud Banner, replaced Zhi at Caishi, and summoned Zhi to serve as Governor of Danyang.

sentences.zh: 昕，慶之之子也。

translations.literal: Xin was the son of Qingzhi.
translations.idiomatic: Xin was the son of Qingzhi.

sentences.zh: 質去採石，而昕猶未下渚。

translations.literal: Zhi left Caishi, but Xin had not yet descended to the landing.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi left Caishi, but Xin had not yet descended to the landing.

sentences.zh: 諜告景云：「質已退。

translations.literal: Spies told Jing, "Zhi has withdrawn.
translations.idiomatic: Spies told Hou Jing, "Zhi has withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 」景使折江東樹枝為驗，諜如言而返，景大喜曰：「吾事辦矣！

translations.literal: " Jing had them break branches east of the river as proof; the spies returned as reported, and Jing rejoiced, saying, "My plan is done!
translations.idiomatic: " Hou Jing had them break branches east of the river as proof; the spies returned as reported, and he rejoiced, saying, "My plan is done!

sentences.zh: 」己酉，自橫江濟於採石，有馬數百匹，兵八千人。

translations.literal: " On jiyou he crossed from Hengjiang to Caishi with several hundred horses and eight thousand troops.
translations.idiomatic: " On jiyou he crossed from Hengjiang to Caishi with several hundred horses and eight thousand troops.

sentences.zh: 是夕，朝廷始命戒嚴。

translations.literal: That evening the court first ordered martial law.
translations.idiomatic: That evening the court first ordered martial law.

sentences.zh: 景分兵襲姑孰，執淮南太守文成侯寧。

translations.literal: Jing divided his forces to seize Gushu and captured Huainan Administrator Marquis Ning of Wencheng.
translations.idiomatic: Hou Jing divided his forces to seize Gushu and captured Huainan Administrator Marquis Ning of Wencheng.

sentences.zh: 南津校尉江子一帥舟師千餘人，欲於下流邀景；

translations.literal: South Ford Commandant Jiang Ziyi led more than a thousand river troops, intending to intercept Jing downstream;
translations.idiomatic: South Ford Commandant Jiang Ziyi led more than a thousand river troops, intending to intercept Hou Jing downstream;

sentences.zh: 其副董桃生，家在江北，與其徒先潰走。

translations.literal: his deputy Dong Taosheng, whose family was north of the river, fled first with his men.
translations.idiomatic: his deputy Dong Taosheng, whose family was north of the river, fled first with his men.

sentences.zh: 子一收餘眾，步還建康。

translations.literal: Ziyi gathered the survivors and walked back to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyi gathered the survivors and walked back to Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 子一，子四之兄也。

translations.literal: Ziyi was the elder brother of Zisi.
translations.idiomatic: Ziyi was the elder brother of Zisi.

sentences.zh: 太子見事急，戎服入見上，稟受方略，上曰：「此自汝事，何更問為！

translations.literal: The crown prince, seeing crisis, entered in armor to ask the emperor for strategy; the emperor said, "This is your affair—why ask further!
translations.idiomatic: The crown prince, seeing crisis, entered in armor to ask the Liang emperor for strategy; the emperor said, "This is your affair—why ask further!

sentences.zh: 內外軍悉以付汝。

translations.literal: All inner and outer forces are entrusted to you.
translations.idiomatic: All inner and outer forces are entrusted to you.

sentences.zh: 」太子乃停中書省，指授軍事，物情惶駭，莫有應募者。

translations.literal: " The prince remained at the Secretariat directing military affairs; public fear ran wild, and none volunteered.
translations.idiomatic: " The prince remained at the Secretariat directing military affairs; public fear ran wild, and none volunteered.

sentences.zh: 朝廷猶不知臨賀王正德之情，命正德屯朱雀門，寧國公大臨屯新亭，太府卿韋黯屯六門，繕修宮城，為受敵之備。

translations.literal: The court still did not know Prince Zhengde of Linhe's treachery; Zhengde was ordered to hold the Vermilion Bird Gate, Duke Dalin of Ningguo to camp at Xinting, Palace Treasurer Wei An to hold the Six Gates; the palace walls were repaired against attack.
translations.idiomatic: The court still did not know Prince Zhengde of Linhe's treachery; Zhengde was ordered to hold the Vermilion Bird Gate, Duke Dalin of Ningguo to camp at Xinting, Palace Treasurer Wei An to hold the Six Gates; the palace walls were repaired against attack.

sentences.zh: 大臨，大器之弟也。

translations.literal: Dalin was the younger brother of Daqi.
translations.idiomatic: Dalin was the younger brother of Daqi.

sentences.zh: 己酉，景至慈湖。

translations.literal: On jiyou, Jing reached Cihu.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, Hou Jing reached Cihu.

sentences.zh: 建康大駭，御街人更相劫掠，不復通行。

translations.literal: Jiankang was terrified; on the imperial avenue people robbed one another and passage ceased.
translations.idiomatic: Jiankang was terrified; on the imperial avenue people robbed one another and passage ceased.

sentences.zh: 赦東、西冶、尚方錢署及建康系囚，以揚州刺史宣城王大器都督城內諸軍事，以羊侃為軍師將軍副之，南浦侯推守東府，西豐公大春守石頭，輕車長史謝禧、始興太守元貞守白下，韋黯與右衛將軍柳津等分守宮城諸門及朝堂。

translations.literal: Prisoners of the eastern and western foundries, the Directorate of Manufactures, the Money Office, and Jiankang jails were pardoned; Yangzhou Inspector Prince Daqi of Xuancheng was made commander of inner-city forces, with Yang Kan as Chief of Staff; Marquis Tui of Nanpu held the Eastern Palace, Duke Dachun of Xifeng held Shitou, Chief Clerk Xie Xi of the Light Chariots and Shixing Administrator Yuan Zhen held Baixia; Wei An and Right Guard General Liu Jin and others divided the palace gates and audience halls.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners of the eastern and western foundries, the Directorate of Manufactures, the Money Office, and Jiankang jails were pardoned; Yangzhou Inspector Prince Daqi of Xuancheng was made commander of inner-city forces, with Yang Kan as Chief of Staff; Marquis Tui of Nanpu held the Eastern Palace, Duke Dachun of Xifeng held Shitou, Chief Clerk Xie Xi and Shixing Administrator Yuan Zhen held Baixia; Wei An and Right Guard General Liu Jin and others divided the palace gates and audience halls.

sentences.zh: 推，秀之子；

translations.literal: Tui was Xiu's son.
translations.idiomatic: Tui was Xiu's son.

sentences.zh: 大春，大臨之弟；

translations.literal: Dachun was Dalin's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Dachun was Dalin's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 津，仲禮之父也。

translations.literal: Jin was Zhongli's father.
translations.idiomatic: Jin was Zhongli's father.

sentences.zh: 擔諸寺庫公藏錢，聚之德陽堂，以充軍實。

translations.literal: Public funds from temple treasuries were gathered at the Hall of Virtue and Virtue to supply the army.
translations.idiomatic: Public funds from temple treasuries were gathered at the Hall of Virtue and Virtue to supply the army.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，侯景至板橋，遣徐思玉來求見上，實欲觀城中虛實。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Hou Jing reached Banqiao and sent Xu Siyu to request an audience—actually to scout the city's strength.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, Hou Jing reached Banqiao and sent Xu Siyu to request an audience—actually to scout the city's strength.

sentences.zh: 上召問之。

translations.literal: The emperor summoned and questioned him.
translations.idiomatic: The Liang emperor summoned and questioned him.

sentences.zh: 思玉詐稱叛景請間陳事，上將屏左右，舍人高善寶曰：「思玉從賊中來，情偽難測，安可使獨在殿上！

translations.literal: Siyu feigned defection to speak privately; as the emperor was about to dismiss attendants, Registrar Gao Shanbao said, "Siyu came from the rebels—his truth is hard to judge; how can he be left alone in the hall!
translations.idiomatic: Siyu feigned defection to speak privately; as the Liang emperor was about to dismiss attendants, Registrar Gao Shanbao said, "Siyu came from the rebels—his truth is hard to judge; how can he be left alone in the hall!

sentences.zh: 」朱異侍坐，曰：「徐思玉豈刺客邪！

translations.literal: " Zhu Yi, seated beside him, said, "Is Xu Siyu an assassin!
translations.idiomatic: " Zhu Yi, seated beside him, said, "Is Xu Siyu an assassin!

sentences.zh: 」思玉出景啟，言「異等弄權，乞帶甲入朝，除君側之惡。

translations.literal: " Siyu produced Jing's memorial, saying, "Yi and the others manipulate power; I beg to enter court in armor and remove the evil at the ruler's side.
translations.idiomatic: " Siyu produced Hou Jing's memorial, saying, "Yi and the others manipulate power; I beg to enter court in armor and remove the evil at the ruler's side.

sentences.zh: 」異甚慚悚。

translations.literal: " Yi was deeply ashamed and alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhu Yi was deeply ashamed and alarmed.

sentences.zh: 景又請遣了事舍人出相領解，上遣中書舍人賀季、主書郭寶亮隨思玉勞景於板橋。

translations.literal: Jing also asked that a capable registrar be sent out to receive and explain; the emperor sent Palace Secretaries He Ji and Chief Clerk Guo Baoliang with Siyu to greet Jing at Banqiao.
